name: mbk-parent-portal-promo
description: Source-faithful Remotion promo-video project for MBK Parent Portal

scripts.render:preview: node scripts/run-remotion.mjs render remotion/index.tsx MBKParentPortalPromo preview.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 23 --scale 0.5 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite && node scripts/normalize-audio.mjs preview.mp4
scripts.render:final: node scripts/run-remotion.mjs render remotion/index.tsx MBKParentPortalPromo final-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 192k --overwrite && node scripts/normalize-audio.mjs final-promo.mp4
scripts.render:short: node scripts/run-remotion.mjs render remotion/index.tsx MBKParentPortalShort short-version.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 19 --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 192k --overwrite && node scripts/normalize-audio.mjs short-version.mp4
scripts.render:thumbnail: node scripts/run-remotion.mjs still remotion/index.tsx MBKParentPortalPromo thumbnail.png --frame 90 --overwrite
